82:The account's Workers Logs are rate limited: `GET /accounts/{id}/observability/usage/limit` (`cf observability usage-limit get`) reports `status: "limited"` and `sample_rate: 0.01`, so Cloudflare keeps a 1% head-based sample of every Worker's events (the documented behaviour once an account passes its daily limit; `resets_at` is null, so do not count on it ending). A single request has a 99% chance of leaving no event. This is why the spike's Main Worker, with logs on and about 25 requests, never showed up.
84:The canary sweep therefore sends its canary 1000 times to each Worker (all lost with probability 0.99^1000 ≈ 4·10⁻⁵). It polls for up to 10 minutes until the Main Worker's canary is found (the positive control), then asserts that the Submission Worker produced zero events and that its canary is in no event. ## Root cause
`SendEmail = Cloudflare.Email.SendEmail("Email")` used the binding name `Email`, which the Email queue's producer binding (`Queue("Email")`) also uses.
